reportOnlyUntil: REPORT ONLY until a steward dispatches it. The lane writes only under BACKFILL_APPLY=true.
finding: 15,763 baseball pool rows sit on `bowman-paper`, which holds ZERO checklist-backed catalog rows in EVERY year measured, while `bowman` is fully checklist-backed in every one.
whatChangedInTheRebuild: EVERY ENTRY NOW CARRIES `fromHobbyiqCardId`. The first cut stored only `fromCardId`, which is the PARTITION KEY — an opaque vendor id for most rows — so the file could not be audited against itself. Diffing `fromCardId` against the destination compared two different fields and produced 1,520 phantom `parallel` changes (`neon-green` -> `base`) that the list never made. Verified against every row's real hobbyiqCardId read from prod: setKey-only on all 15,767 readable entries, ZERO off-axis.

THE CROSS-IDENTITY GUARD NOW CHECKS THE SETKEY. It checked sport and year only, so one row whose cardId named `bowman-npb` (Japanese Bowman, a different product) was admitted. That row is excluded here and the exclusion is counted.
THE BUILD ASSERTS ITS OWN INVARIANT. Before writing, every entry is re-diffed segment by segment; a single non-setKey difference aborts the build. This file exists only because that assertion passed.
rulings: THIS IS A FOLD, NOT A RUNG-MEMBERSHIP MOVE. `bowman-paper` is an alias, not a product, so every row on it belongs on `bowman` whatever its rung. No rung test is applied and none would be meaningful.
NOTHING IS TAKEN FROM A CHECKLIST THAT NAMES IT: `bowman-paper` holds 0 checklist-backed rows in every year measured.
SETKEY IS THE ONLY AXIS THAT CHANGES. parallel, cardNumber, isAuto, printRun and the grade tail are copied verbatim from the row's own slug.
TWO SHAPES: slug cardId -> RELOCATE (setKey is in the partition key, so the row really moves); opaque vendor cardId -> REPOINT (hobbyiqCardId patched in place, #1941 address guard runs).

census.note: read from prod read-only on 2026-09-15, paged by (sport, year, setKey) slug prefix; no cross-partition COUNT over sold_comps.
